bio: The centuries-old castle set in extensive grounds really is a magnificent property. Behind the massive stone walls, stylish rooms and lounges with period details await. This stately backdrop makes for a fabulous setting in which to relish the modern cuisine with classic foundations, served à la carte or as a menu comprising three to six courses. Caviar or oysters are also popular appetisers. Friendly and attentive service. An adjacent building accommodates overnight guests in three pretty apartments....
